title: Trader Diary: 3 AM Leverage Roulette
content:
🚀 Spot: “Buy the dip, HODL forever.”
📈 Futures: “Double‑down, the dip is just a coffee break.”
💤 4 AM: Watching the 1‑minute chart like it’s a Netflix thriller.
lesson: If your stop‑loss is farther than your coffee, you’re over‑leveraged.
question: Who else was up at 3 AM staring at a 0.02% candle? Drop your war stories 👇
